name: @coding-adventures/forme-doc-frontmatter
description: Strip YAML or TOML frontmatter from a markdown source string.  Returns { body, frontmatter }.  YAML uses an in-house tiny subset parser; TOML delegates to @coding-adventures/toml-parser (full TOML 1.0 lexer+grammar) and walks the AST to enforce the docs-frontmatter subset.  No eval, no prototype pollution.  Pure transform (capabilities: []).  DOC00 v0 content-pipeline package.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
